checkedAlternates.risk: 304 Not Modified indicates a valid cache hit.
checkedAlternates.resolution: 304 belongs to the 3xx Redirection class (group-2), not 2xx.

checkedAlternates.risk: 502 Bad Gateway is an error response like 4xx.
checkedAlternates.resolution: 5xx codes indicate server-side failures (group-1), distinct from 4xx client errors (group-4).
